name: Aotum8 Review Manager
author: aotum8labs

sections.description:
Managing WooCommerce reviews manually can take time and make it harder to identify recurring customer concerns.

Aotum8 Review Manager helps store owners review WooCommerce feedback, identify sentiment, prepare professional replies, and keep review workflows organized from the WordPress admin area.

Included Features

  • Centralized Dashboard: View and manage all your WooCommerce product reviews from one clean, analytics-driven interface.
  • Manual Approval Workflow: Keep full control over which reviews go live on your store.
  • Standard Offline Templates: Save time with pre-built, professional templates for common customer complaints or praises.
  • WooCommerce Native Integration: Seamlessly hooks into your existing WooCommerce product data and customer profiles.
  • Optional AI Provider Support: Connect supported third-party AI providers with your own API key to analyze review sentiment and draft replies. This is fully included, with no restrictions or additional purchase required.
  • Provider Fallback: Configure provider credentials so analysis can try another configured provider if the selected provider fails.
  • Human-in-the-loop by default: AI-drafted replies are saved as a suggestion for you to review, not published automatically. Full automation is available as an opt-in setting.

External services

This plugin can connect to third-party AI APIs when you choose AI-powered analysis and provide your own API key. If you use offline templates only, no AI provider request is sent.

When AI analysis is enabled, the plugin sends the WooCommerce review text and prompt instructions needed to generate sentiment and a suggested merchant reply. Provider API keys are stored in your WordPress database and are sent only to the provider you configure when an analysis request is made.

Supported services:

  • OpenAI API – used to analyze review sentiment and draft replies. Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
  • Groq API – used to analyze review sentiment and draft replies. Terms: https://groq.com/terms-of-use/ Privacy: https://groq.com/privacy-policy/
  • Google Gemini API / Generative Language API – used to analyze review sentiment and draft replies. Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • DeepSeek API – used to analyze review sentiment and draft replies. Terms: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-terms-of-use.html Privacy: https://cdn.deepseek.com/policies/en-US/deepseek-privacy-policy.html
  • Anthropic Claude API – used to analyze review sentiment and draft replies. Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Xiaomi MiMo API – used to analyze review sentiment and draft replies when configured. Terms: https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/docs/terms/user-agreement Privacy: https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/docs/en-US/terms/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aotum8-review-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly through your site plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in your admin area.
  3. Navigate to the “Aotum8 Reviews” menu in your admin sidebar to complete the setup wizard.
sections.faq:
Does this require an OpenAI API Key?

No. Offline templates work without an API key. Optional AI analysis requires your own API key for the provider you choose.

Will this slow down my store?

No. Aotum8 Review Manager operates in the admin backend and does not add frontend storefront assets.

Can I customize the AI’s reply tone?

Yes. You can provide custom system instructions (e.g., “Reply like a friendly surfer”, or “Be highly professional and corporate”).

Will AI replies be posted to my store automatically?

Not unless you turn that on. By default, AI-generated replies are saved as a draft suggestion on the review’s comment edit screen for you to review and publish manually. There is an “Automatically publish AI replies” setting if you want full automation.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3

  • Fixed “Support” and “Documentation” links that pointed to a domain and email address that don’t exist yet – now point to the real WordPress.org support forum and plugin page.

1.0.2

  • Updated “Tested up to” to the current WordPress version.

1.0.1

  • All AI-powered review analysis and reply drafting is now included at no cost, using your own API key – no restricted or locked functionality remains in this plugin.
  • AI-drafted and template replies are no longer published to your storefront automatically; added an opt-in “Automatically publish AI replies” setting plus a manual “Publish this reply now” action.
  • Fixed API key handling so keys are no longer altered by a text-sanitization filter meant for display text.
  • Corrected the default Xiaomi MiMo API endpoint and model names.
  • Replaced inline script/style output with properly enqueued assets.
  • Dashboard sentiment breakdown now renders with no external chart library dependency.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release in the plugin directory.
  • Introduced core review management dashboard.
  • Added manual approval workflows and offline templates.
  • Added optional AI provider configuration using user-supplied API keys.
